description: Comprehensive pharmaceutical regulatory intelligence MCP server. 4 tools across 7 databases and 45,000+ records. Look up drugs across DrugBank (4,947 compounds), WHO Essential Medicines (782), Australian TGA (23,259 registered medicines), and FDA NDI notifications (1,330). Check drug-drug interactions (5,000 documented interactions) with severity grouping. Query FDA FAERS adverse event reports (2,000 top drugs). Full-text search across all pharmaceutical databases including ChEMBL bioactivity (7,941 records). Built by Two Halves — twohalves.ai
